parts.text: 请独立用webfetch实际读取 https://www.w3.org/robots.txt 和 https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/text-decoration ，并用read读取当前项目已有README.md的前20行。只读这些资源，不搜索其他资料，不委托成员，不修改文件或发布产物。完成后用中文约150字概括三份资料用途，保留真实来源。

- [W3C robots.txt](https://www.w3.org/robots.txt)规定爬虫抓取范围，限制后台、维基操作及部分高成本路径，并允许链接检查器访问全站。
- [MDN text-decoration](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/text-decoration)介绍文字装饰简写属性，用于设置线型、颜色、样式与粗细，提供语法和示例。
- 当前项目 `README.md:1` 仅有一行标题“Isolated formal Task resource qualification”，用于标识项目主题，暂无具体使用说明。
请独立只用webfetch读取公开的 https://api.github.com/ ，不要使用任何认证信息，不查询其他地址，不委托成员或修改文件。完成后只回复一句话概括用途，保留真实来源。
[GitHub API 根端点](https://api.github.com/)用于提供仓库、用户、组织、搜索等 API 的入口地址及 URL 模板，便于发现可调用的接口。

[text-decoration](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/text-decoration) # `text-decoration` CSS property Baseline Widely available \* This feature is well established and works across many devices and browser versions. It’s been available across browsers since July 2015. \* Some parts of this feature may have varying levels of support. - [See full compatibility](#browser_compatibility) - [Learn more](/en-US/docs/Glossary/Baseline/Compatibility) The **`text-decoration`** [CSS](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS) [shorthand](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Guides/Cascade/Shorthand_properties) property sets the appearance of decorative lines on text. It is a shorthand for [`text-decoration-line`](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/text-decoration-line), [`text-decoration-color`](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/text-decoration-color), [`text-decoration-style`](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/text-decoration-style), and the newer [`text-decoration-thickness`](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/text-decoration-thickness) property. Text decorations are drawn across descendant text elements. This means that if an element specifies a text decoration, then a child element can't remove the decoration. For example, in the markup `

This text has some emphasized words in it.

`, the style rule `p { text-decoration: underline; }` would cause the entire paragraph to be underlined. The style rule `em { text-decoration: none; }` would not cause any change; the entire paragraph would still be underlined. However, the rule `em { text-decoration: overline; }` would cause a second decoration to appear on "some emphasized words". ## In this article - [Try it](#try_it) - [Constituent properties](#constituent_properties) - [Syntax](#syntax) - [Formal definition](#formal_definition) - [Formal syntax](#formal_syntax) - [Examples](#examples) - [Specifications](#specifications) - [Browser compatibility](#browser_compatibility) - [See also](#see_also) ## [Try it](#try_it) ``` text-decoration: underline; ``` ``` text-decoration: underline dotted; ``` ``` text-decoration: underline dotted red; ``` ``` text-decoration: green wavy underline; ``` ``` text-decoration: underline overline #ff3028; ``` ```

[`text-decoration-color`](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/text-decoration-color) Sets the color of the decoration. [`text-decoration-style`](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/text-decoration-style) Sets the style of the line used for the decoration, such as `solid`, `wavy`, or `dashed`. [`text-decoration-thickness`](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/text-decoration-thickness) Sets the thickness of the line used for the decoration. ## [Formal definition](#formal_definition) [Initial value](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Guides/Cascade/Property_value_processing#initial_value) as each of the properties of the shorthand: - [`text-decoration-color`](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/text-decoration-color): `currentcolor` - [`text-decoration-style`](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/text-decoration-style): `solid` - [`text-decoration-line`](/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/text-decoration-line): `none` Applies to all elements.
